result.reasoning: This commit ("Fix IllegalStateException in DownloadWizardProvider") introduced the MOUSE_TRANSPARENT property mechanism, setting mouseTransparent on previousNode (storing/restoring its prior state) instead of on the whole view. The fix commit 2324af649c2c reverts exactly this logic, replacing per-node mouseTransparent get/set with view.setMouseTransparent(true/false) and removing the MOUSE_TRANSPARENT constant that was added here. The intermediate commit e9db183d545b only wrapped this same logic in Platform.runLater without altering the semantics, so it's not the origin of the bug.
